top_signals.title: ABS, HD KSOE, Siemens to Develop Ammonia Vessel Safety Digital Twin
top_signals.summary: American Bureau of Shipping (ABS), HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering (HDKSOE) and Siemens have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop digital twin technology for assessing leak behavior and safety aboard ammonia-fueled vessels.The collaboration…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: SpaceX Launches Crew for NASA on Retiring Dragon Capsule
top_signals.summary: SpaceX launched a new crew of four astronauts to the International Space Station on Thursday, as questions swirl over the company’s plans for the future of its human spaceflight program. Bloomberg's Loren Grush joins Ed Ludlow as the crew lifts off on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
